extracted.name: Healthy Banana Muffins
extracted.description: Delicious, healthy muffins! Super moist and filling!!!🥰😘
ingredient_lines: 1/4 cup honey or maple syrup preferred
instruction_lines: Put bananas and oats in blender and blend
Add the other ingredients but not the toppings and blend
Pour around a 1/4 cup batter into a lined muffin tray
Chop nuts and sprinkle toppings on top
Place in oven for 20-30 minutes until the tops bounce when you tap them
